svg.aria-label: Work: Upswing, Cognitive Hospitality Solutions. Jr. Backend Developer (Part-time) (Apr – Oct 2026). Software Developer Intern (Feb – Apr 2026). Built a staff agent on an MCP server, then rebuilt it as a read-only RAG agent with document citations and role-based access. Led 2 of the 11 live hotel PMS integrations (StayNtouch, Hop) and took StayNtouch through vendor pre-certification. Shipped a versioned prompt service that hot-reloads prompts over RabbitMQ, so prompt changes no longer need a redeploy. Hardened the platform with rate limits, Origin allow-lists and LLM-outage detection, and fixed RabbitMQ and MongoDB connection leaks. ~178× faster hotel availability checks. 11 s → 4 ms webhook credential lookup. 40+ organizations on the 27-service platform.
